as_a_slide: Mostly yes. All five zones are clear of objects, warm and light enough for dark type, and each sits right beside its product, so a reader pairs name and object without leader lines. The shared green makes 'they go together' land at a glance. The weaknesses: the brightest thing on the slide is the blown cream rug in the lower centre, not a product, so the eye goes to the floor before the labels; the header zone is darker and more uneven than the others; and the symmetrical, showroom look undersells 'furniture magazine'. Fixing c1, c2 and c5 alone would make it a good slide.
changes: c1 the rug clipped (25 % of its centre): sun 36 -> 18 W/m2, 12 degrees
c2 one light: bounce 1.2 -> 0.5, north 1.2 warmed #F2E6D6, exposure 1.25
c4 contact: the right card 0.2, more transmission bounces, spike discs
c5 the skirting the wall colour
